title: Vagus nerve stimulation
summary: Four parasympathetic-leaning approaches under one activity: cold face immersion, baking soda water, castor oil navel, and tuning forks.

sections.heading: Why these are grouped
sections.body: Cold face immersion, baking soda water, castor oil at the navel, and tuning-fork vibration are often taught as parasympathetic / vagus-adjacent self-care. Treating them as related practices keeps the guide clearer without suggesting that one practice replaces the others. You can practice more than one mode in a day.

sections.heading: Modes and approaches
sections.body: Cold face immersion — 3 rounds of cold water on the face or brief head immersion. Baking soda water — ¼ tsp sodium bicarbonate in a glass, at least 2 hours from meals. Castor oil navel — organic cold-pressed castor oil drops in the belly button. Tuning forks — real metal 40 Hz / weighted C128 session. Equipment differs by approach: forks and castor need gear; baking soda and face cold are low-gear.

sections.heading: Practical safety notes
sections.body: Cold face: stop for chest pain, panic that does not settle, or dizziness—entry-level cold, not a full plunge. Baking soda: ask a clinician if you have sodium restriction, kidney or heart disease; never replace prescribed care. Castor: external navel use only, patch-test first; never ingest raw castor beans. Forks: stop for ear pain, headache, or joint discomfort. None of these modes diagnose or treat vagus-nerve disorders.

sections.heading: Where Dr. Jack Kruse’s teaching is specific
sections.body: Kruse and overlapping lifestyle communities discuss cold facial immersion, alkalizing mineral habits, castor rituals, and sound/vibration tools as ways to bias toward parasympathetic tone inside a wider light–water–magnetism day. The bundled “vagus” label in this guide is organizational teaching language—not a claim that each mode electrically paces the vagus like a medical VNS implant.

sections.heading: What is solid, what is framework
sections.body: Solid ground: facial cold can trigger diving-reflex bradycardia; chewing/breathing and calm sensory input can feel settling; sodium bicarbonate is a real antacid chemistry with dose limits. Framework: that practicing these modes equals clinical vagus-nerve stimulation or cures autonomic disease. Use as optional Support self-care beside sleep, light, and movement basics.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: Practice Vagus nerve stimulation and pick a mode. Read the cold-face, baking-soda, castor-oil, and tuning-forks lessons for depth. Progress from cold face toward full Cold thermogenesis when ready. Educational only—not medical device therapy.
